parser.contract: Ordinary transactional files pass content unchanged to splitAndTrim.

apply.contract: History insert receives exact parseMigrationContent statements, without injected execution role restores.

method.sourceTransformation: Existing pinned TypeScript transpileModule only; no edited/reimplemented splitter.
method.digest: SHA256 of UTF-8 statements joined by exactly one U+000A newline; equivalent to PostgreSQL array_to_string(statements, chr(10)) for this non-null array.
method.statementTransform: Pinned splitter trims terminating semicolons and surrounding whitespace; preserves internal comments/newlines/dollar-quoted function bodies.
reproduction: Download the immutable public splitter URL as UTF-8 without a BOM and assert source SHA256.
Transpile the unchanged source using repository TypeScript transpileModule with target ES2022/module ES2022.
Import the generated JavaScript as an in-memory data URL; call its exported splitAndTrim on each actual UTF-8 migration file.
Assert all nine baseline/pending entries from scripts/db/m03-dev-migration-packet.json match their historySha256 before trusting the final derivation.

note: This predicts exact pinned CLI history encoding from frozen source. It does not claim that the final migration was applied, or that its hosted history already matches.
